pkgmetadata.longdescription: Luciole is a native Wayland file manager using C++23 and OpenGL ES. It provides grid, list and Miller column views, tabs, split views, asynchronous file previews, archive handling, GVfs integration and a FileChooser backend for xdg-desktop-portal, without Qt or GTK widgets.

use.flag: Enable WebDAV access through GVfs with GIO TLS support.
Install Poppler utilities for PDF previews and metadata.
Enable SMB access through the GVfs Samba backend.
Install FFmpeg and ffmpegthumbnailer for media previews and metadata.
Enable DNS-SD network discovery through GVfs and Avahi.
